BiblicalUsage: Zephon is a son of Gad, named in the census of Israel in the wilderness. In Numbers 26:15, of Zephon, the family of the Zephonites.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that Zephon belongs in the story because God put the name there, and I trust the placing.
